author: Ubisoft YouTube
text:
Anno 117: Pax Romana - Dawn of the Delta Launch Trailer
In Dawn of the Delta, establish your rule in Aegyptus, a new province shaped by its mighty river. Build on desert lands and master the floods to reap bountiful harvests. Choose whether to govern the local Aegyptians or Graeco-Romans, and unlock unique new technologies and military units exclusive to this province. Face off against the local raider, and take on the ambitious project of restoring the Great Pyramids for the glory of Rome.

About Anno 117: Pax Romana:
In the latest instalment of the award-winning Anno strategy franchise, it’s your destiny to shape the Roman Empire in the year 117 AD. As governor, will you encourage economic growth or expand your rule through dominance? Lead with rebellion or unite a diverse culture? 
The cost of peace is yours to decide.
